scope: Conditional logical and arbitrary-row publication laws, assuming complete faithful failure accounting and delayed publication. No executable, native, source-authentication, compiler refinement or total CPU/heap theorem. Inline constant independence and catalog presence are definition-level laws with separate Bun/Chromium controls.

queries.smt:
(declare-sort Witness 0)
(declare-fun truth (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun present (Witness) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((w Witness))
             (=> (present w) (and (>= (truth w) 0) (<= (truth w) 2)))))
      (a!2 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 2))))
      (a!3 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 1)))))
  (and a!1 a!2 (distinct (ite a!2 2 (ite a!3 1 0)) 2))))
queries.scope: Assumes complete identical witness population and already validated scalar truth; not executable refinement.

(declare-sort Witness 0)
(declare-fun truth (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun present (Witness) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((w Witness))
             (=> (present w) (and (>= (truth w) 0) (<= (truth w) 2)))))
      (a!2 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 2))))
      (a!3 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 1)))))
  (and a!1 (not a!2) a!3 (distinct (ite a!2 2 (ite a!3 1 0)) 1))))

queries.smt:
(declare-sort Witness 0)
(declare-fun truth (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun present (Witness) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 2))))
      (a!2 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 1)))))
  (and (forall ((w Witness)) (not (present w)))
       (distinct (ite a!1 2 (ite a!2 1 0)) 0))))
queries.scope: Completeness is a premise; no closed-world inference from missing facts.

queries.smt:
(declare-sort Witness 0)
(declare-fun truth (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun present (Witness) Bool)
(declare-fun b () Witness)
(declare-fun a () Witness)
(assert (let ((a!1 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 2))))
      (a!2 (exists ((w Witness)) (and (present w) (= (truth w) 1)))))
  (and (distinct a b)
       (present a)
       (present b)
       (= (truth a) 2)
       (= (truth b) 1)
       (= (ite a!1 2 (ite a!2 1 0)) 2))))
(model-add b () Witness Witness!val!1)
(model-add a () Witness Witness!val!0)
(model-add w!2 () Witness Witness!val!2)
(model-add truth ((x!1 Witness)) Int (ite (= x!1 Witness!val!1) 1 2))
(model-add present ((x!1 Witness)) Bool true)
queries.model:
[b = Witness!val!1,
 a = Witness!val!0,
 present = [else -> True],
 truth = [Witness!val!1 -> 1, else -> 2]]
queries.scope: Concrete nonvacuity witness, not native/source authenticity.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun graphComplete () Bool)
(declare-fun endpointComplete () Bool)
(assert (and endpointComplete (not graphComplete)))
(model-add endpointComplete () Bool true)
(model-add graphComplete () Bool false)
queries.scope: Independent host coverage attestations require separate admission.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun conflict () Bool)
(declare-fun withheld () Bool)
(assert (and withheld conflict (distinct (ite withheld 0 (ite conflict 1 2)) 0)))
queries.scope: Conditional disposition selection law; transform execution not modeled.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun granted () Bool)
(declare-fun declared () Bool)
(assert (and declared (not granted)))
(model-add declared () Bool true)
(model-add granted () Bool false)

(declare-fun limit () Int)
(declare-fun inc () Int)
(declare-fun prior () Int)
(assert (and (>= prior 0)
     (>= inc 0)
     (>= limit 0)
     (<= (+ prior inc) limit)
     (> (+ prior inc) limit)))
queries.scope: Assumes every modeled traversal contributes a nonnegative charge before work; concrete source controls required.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun inc () Int)
(declare-fun limit () Int)
(declare-fun prior () Int)
(assert (and (= prior 30000)
     (= inc 30000)
     (= limit 50000)
     (<= prior limit)
     (<= inc limit)
     (> (+ prior inc) limit)))
(model-add inc () Int 30000)
(model-add limit () Int 50000)
(model-add prior () Int 30000)

(declare-fun rowPermitted (Int) Bool)
(declare-fun selectedRow () Int)
(declare-fun rows () Int)
(declare-fun badRowPredicate (Int) Bool)
(declare-fun badRow () Int)
(assert (let ((a!1 (not (exists ((badRow Int))
                  (and (>= badRow 0) (< badRow rows) (badRowPredicate badRow))))))
  (and (> rows 0)
       (>= badRow 0)
       (< badRow rows)
       (badRowPredicate badRow)
       a!1
       (>= selectedRow 0)
       (< selectedRow rows)
       (rowPermitted selectedRow))))
queries.scope: Assumes complete preflight/render failures are faithfully represented by bad and publication waits for whole-batch admission; not TS refinement.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun badRow () Int)
(declare-fun rows () Int)
(declare-fun selectedRow () Int)
(declare-fun badRowPredicate (Int) Bool)
(declare-fun rowPermitted (Int) Bool)
(assert (and (= rows 2)
     (= badRow 1)
     (= selectedRow 0)
     (badRowPredicate badRow)
     (rowPermitted selectedRow)
     (not (badRowPredicate selectedRow))))
(model-add badRow () Int 1)
(model-add rows () Int 2)
(model-add selectedRow () Int 0)
(model-add rowPermitted ((x!1 Int)) Bool true)
(model-add badRowPredicate ((x!1 Int)) Bool (not (= x!1 0)))
queries.model:
[selectedRow = 0,
 rows = 2,
 badRow = 1,
 rowPermitted = [else -> True],
 badRowPredicate = [0 -> False, else -> True]]
queries.scope: Streaming a valid prefix before a later failure leaks partial output; no native model.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun rows () Int)
(declare-fun badRowPredicate (Int) Bool)
(declare-fun rowPermitted (Int) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (not (exists ((badRow Int))
                  (and (>= badRow 0) (< badRow rows) (badRowPredicate badRow))))))
  (and (= rows 2)
       (rowPermitted 0)
       (not (rowPermitted 1))
       (forall ((badRow Int)) (not (badRowPredicate badRow)))
       a!1)))
(model-add rows () Int 2)
(model-add rowPermitted ((x!1 Int)) Bool (not (= x!1 1)))
(model-add badRowPredicate ((x!1 Int)) Bool false)
queries.model:
[rows = 2,
 rowPermitted = [1 -> False, else -> True],
 badRowPredicate = [else -> False]]
queries.scope: Concrete nonempty admitted population with a filtered denied row.

(declare-fun inlineOutput () Int)
(declare-fun sourcePresent () Bool)

     (= inlineOutput constantValue)
     (distinct inlineOutput constantValue)))
